new_learnings.text: Sector rotation from tech to agriculture/cyclicals confirmed: 通信设备(-2.80%), 光伏设备(-2.41%), 元件(-2.16%) all in bottom 5 while 养殖业(+6.97%), 教育(+5.46%) lead. When the candidate pool is tech-heavy and no candidate aligns with hot sectors, default to cash even when breadth clears the buy gate.
new_learnings.mechanism: Sector gravity determines ~40% of individual stock returns in A-shares. Buying a good stock in a rotating-out sector means fighting macro flows. The breadth was 4.89:1 bullish, but the money was flowing into agriculture/cyclicals, not into our tech-heavy candidate pool.

new_learnings.text: The V2 -3% in 3 days rule caught 恒铭达 at -3.87% in just 2 days — much faster than V1's -10%/20-day rules. The thesis ('MA20下方低吸') was invalidated immediately. This rule is doing exactly what it was designed to do: kill bad timing fast before it becomes a -8% loss.
new_learnings.mechanism: Stocks that drop -3% in the first 1-3 days after entry almost always have deeper problems (sector rotation, institutional selling, catalyst invalidation). The market is telling you your timing was wrong — listen.

new_learnings.text: Intraday reversal from 24-month high on 6.5× normal volume (鹏辉能源: ¥92.32 → ¥75.47, ~18% swing) is a strong distribution signal. Even when PnL hasn't hit -3%, this price action pattern warrants immediate stop-tightening or proactive exit. Consider adding an 'intraday reversal > 10% from high' rule for positions held < 5 days.
new_learnings.mechanism: Institutions use strength to distribute. A pop to new highs followed by a full reversal on massive volume means smart money is selling into retail enthusiasm. This pattern has high predictive value for further downside in the next 1-3 days.

new_learnings.text: MA-distance Rule 2b filtered out 20+ overextended candidates today. Without this rule, V2 would have bought stocks like 新洁能 (dist_ma5=10.8%), 多氟多 (dist_ma5=16.4%), 华灿光电 (dist_ma5=15.6%) — all of which would have been chasing into mean-reversion risk. This confirms the rule is essential, not optional.
new_learnings.mechanism: Stocks that spike 10%+ above MA5 have a high probability of mean-reverting within 3-5 days. The best entries happen near MA5/MA10 support, not 10%+ above them. This is a statistical edge, not an opinion.
